notes: Not the finished batteries-included composition. It selects the herdr agent-state reporter (Package components/herdr, Go), PiG Runner and Angry Pigs (Packages pig-runner, angry-pigs, Go, moved from PiG Standard; they draw the pig chosen with PiG's built-in /sprite), the Pig Snake game (Package components/pig-snake, Go, starts only on /pig-snake), the read_session tool (Package components/session-ingest, Go), the /context, /tools, /cost and /prompts commands (Package components/context-info, Go; its footer is opt-in), the pig-doctor /doctor command (Package components/pig-doctor, Go; command only, nothing runs automatically), the a2a Package (Package components/a2a, Go: A2A tools, listener off until configured), the websearch first slice (Package components/websearch, Go: web_search, fetch_content, get_search_content, source_check, web_enable; the rest of pi-web-access is deferred and named in its PORT.md), the pig-music player (Package components/pig-music, Go: /music, alt+m), plus an empty build-pipeline fixture (seed-check, Go). The roadmap is approved; capability ports are pending implementation.

The games start only on their command (/runner, /pig-runner, /angry-pigs, /pig-snake). Bundling is not activating. The sprite login and /sprite are PiG's own (built in since 0.4.0); this Piglet no longer bundles one.

It also selects Jev (components/jev), a typed judge for tool calls and output. Selectable and off by default: nothing is judged or sent until you run /jev on, which shows what leaves the machine and where. It fails open. The standalone jev Piglet and this one both build a Binary locally.

pig-music is a full-screen YouTube Music player. Nothing starts or runs until you type `/music` (or a /music subcommand or alt+m): no mpv or yt-dlp process, no network, no cookie access, no footer or widget and no timer; at startup it only reads its settings and looks for its own mpv socket, and follows an mpv from an earlier session that is already playing (footer only). It needs mpv and yt-dlp with a JS runtime on the machine: /music always plays through mpv (the native engine is used only by the separate pigmusic command). The first /music checks the machine and /music setup offers a consent-gated download of yt-dlp and Deno; the library tab reads a browser's cookies only after a one-time consent per browser.
The herdr reporter does nothing unless PiG runs inside a herdr pane. Every extension in this Piglet is Go, so it needs no Node.js.

A local Piglet Binary builds with the reviewed PiG. Signed Binaries for the five manifest targets are published as GitHub Release pig-with-batteries/v0.1.2 (the latest; pull one with pig piglet pull github:MichaelKinsy/pigpen/pig-with-batteries@0.1.2); the local runs in this repository are linux/amd64 only, and the targets are not a support claim.

Per-Piglet release tags and signed Binary pulls are in use for this composition (pig piglet pull github:MichaelKinsy/pigpen/pig-with-batteries@0.1.2); remote source add is not offered. See RELEASE-BLOCKERS.md, a record of what blocked the first release.
